endpoints.truth_yaml:
put:
  summary: Set a project member cost rate
  description: |
    Updates the cost rate for a specific user on a project.
    Rate changes flow through every future time entry on this project.
  operationId: updateProjectUserCostRate
  parameters:
    - name: workspaceId
      in: path
      required: true
      schema:
        type: string
    - name: projectId
      in: path
      required: true
      schema:
        type: string
    - name: userId
      in: path
      required: true
      schema:
        type: string
  requestBody:
    required: true
    content:
      application/json:
        schema:
          type: object
          properties:
            amount:
              type: integer
              minimum: 0
            since:
              type: string
  responses:
    '200':
      description: Project returned with updated membership rates
endpoints.notes: LIVE-VERIFIED. GET probe returns 405, confirming path registration. Live PUT returned 200 with cost rate applied to project membership. Path matches official spec. No discrepancies.

endpoints.truth_yaml:
put:
  summary: Publish draft scheduling assignments
  description: |
    Publishes all draft scheduling assignments within the start-to-end window,
    making them visible to users. The Clockify endpoint returns no response body;
    success is indicated by HTTP 200.
  operationId: publishSchedulingAssignments
  parameters:
    - name: workspaceId
      in: path
      required: true
      schema:
        type: string
  requestBody:
    required: true
    content:
      application/json:
        schema:
          type: object
          required:
            - start
            - end
          properties:
            start:
              type: string
              description: Publish window start (RFC3339)
            end:
              type: string
              description: Publish window end (RFC3339)
            notifyUsers:
              type: boolean
              default: false
  responses:
    '200':
      description: Assignments published successfully (no response body)
endpoints.notes: LIVE-VERIFIED. GET returns 405 confirming path registration. Live PUT with real range returned 200 with published:true. Source 'both' is correct - path matches official Clockify scheduling API.

endpoints.truth_yaml:
patch:
  summary: Update a recurring scheduling assignment
  description: |
    Updates one or more occurrences of a recurring scheduling assignment.
    seriesUpdateOption controls scope (THIS_ONE, THIS_AND_FOLLOWING, ALL).
  operationId: updateRecurringSchedulingAssignment
  parameters:
    - name: workspaceId
      in: path
      required: true
      schema:
        type: string
    - name: assignmentId
      in: path
      required: true
      schema:
        type: string
  requestBody:
    required: true
    content:
      application/json:
        schema:
          type: object
          properties:
            start:
              type: string
            end:
              type: string
            hoursPerDay:
              type: number
            billable:
              type: boolean
            seriesUpdateOption:
              type: string
              enum:
                - THIS_ONE
                - THIS_AND_FOLLOWING
                - ALL
  responses:
    '200':
      description: Array of updated assignment objects
endpoints.notes: LIVE-VERIFIED for PATCH method. The path family /scheduling/assignments/recurring/{id} is confirmed live (GET=405, PATCH=200). Source is correctly listed as 'ours-only' for the PUT variant - official docs may only document PATCH. Our typed tool uses PATCH. The PUT variant in the raw allowlist may be a documentation artifact from an older API version; PATCH is the confirmed working method.
